# International Journal of Pharmaceutical Sciences

> Open-access peer-reviewed journal publishing cutting-edge research in pharmaceutical sciences, drug delivery systems, formulation development, and clinical pharmacy practice.

IJPS is a monthly open-access journal dedicated to advancing pharmaceutical research and practice. The journal covers diverse topics including innovative drug delivery technologies, analytical methodologies, phytochemical investigations, and clinical applications in pharmacy practice across institutions in India and globally.

## Key Topics

- Drug Delivery Systems
- Pharmaceutical Formulation
- HPLC Analysis
- Phytochemical Analysis
- Tablet Evaluation
- Nanoparticles
- Transdermal Drug Delivery
- Drug Utilization Patterns
- Herbal Medicine
- Targeted Therapy
- Gastroretentive Systems
- Personalized Medicine
- Machine Learning in Pharmacy
- Antimicrobial Activity
- Analytical Methodologies

## Journal & Access

- [International Journal of Pharmaceutical Sciences | Open Access](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/issues-details/2023/7/1): Monthly open access journal publishing pharmaceutical sciences research
- [Open Access Policy | INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/open-access-policy): Journal open access policy ensuring free article availability globally

## Advanced Drug Delivery Systems

- [Transferosomes: A Novel Approach To Drug Delivery](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Transferosomes:-A-Novel-Approach-To-Drug-Delivery): Review of transferosomes as nanovesicular drug delivery systems
- [A Overview of the Transdermal Drug Delivery System](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/A-Overview-of-the-Transdermal-Drug-Delivery-System): Transdermal patch systems for controlled-release drug delivery
- [Smart Drug Delivery System](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Smart-Drug-Delivery-System): Stimuli-responsive smart systems using nanoparticles and liposomes
- [Review On Liquisolid Compacts An Approach To Enhance The Solubility Of Bcs Class Ii Drugs](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Review-On-Liquisolid-Compacts-An-Approach-To-Enhance-The-Solubility-Of-Bcs-Class-Ii-Drugs): Liquisolid compacts for solubility enhancement of poorly soluble drugs
- [A Review on Nanorobotics](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/A-Review-on-Nanorobotics): Review of nanobots and nanoelectromechanical systems in drug delivery

## Pharmaceutical Formulation & Evaluation

- [Formulation And Evaluation of Erythromycin Delayed Release Tablets](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Formulation-And-Evaluation-of-Erythromycin-Delayed-Release-Tablets): Enteric-coated erythromycin tablet formulation with dissolution studies
- [Development And Evaluation Of Pressed Coated Floting Pulsatile Tablet Of Atenolol](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Development-And-Evaluation-Of-Pressed-Coated-Floting-Pulsatile-Tablet-Of-Atenolol): Pulsatile floating tablet of atenolol for hypertension treatment
- [Formulation And Evaluation of Gel Containing Zinc Oxide Nanoparticle of Ketoconazole With Aqueous Honey Solution](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Formulation-And-Evaluation-of-Gel-Containing-Zinc-Oxide-Nanoparticle-of-Ketoconazole-With-Aqueous-Honey-Solution): Zinc oxide nanoparticle gel formulation for antifungal ketoconazole
- [Formulation Development and Evaluation Of Wax Incorporated Floating Beads Of Dalfampridine](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Formulation-Development-and-Evaluation-Of-Wax-Incorporated-Floating-Beads-Of-Dalfampridine): Wax-incorporated floating beads for gastroretentive dalfampridine delivery

## Analytical Methods & Drug Analysis

- [A Review on Various Analytical Methodologies for Buspirone](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/A-Review-on-Various-Analytical-Methodologies-for-Buspirone): Analytical methods review for buspirone drug estimation via chromatography
- [An Overview of The Hyphenated Separation Technology and its Application in the Pharmacy](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/An-Overview-of-The-Hyphenated-Separation-Technology-and-its-Application-in-the-Pharmacy): Hyphenated chromatography-mass spectrometry for pharmaceutical analysis

## Phytochemistry & Herbal Medicine

- [Extraction, Phytochemical Investigation and Antimicrobial Activity of Hibiscus Rosa Sinensis](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Extraction,-Phytochemical-Investigation-and-Antimicrobial-Activity-of-Hibiscus-Rosa-Sinensis): Phytochemical analysis and antimicrobial testing of hibiscus plant extract
- [Scientific Review on Kumud: Nymphaea alba linn.](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Scientific-Review-on-Kumud:-Nymphaea-alba-linn.): Ayurvedic plant Nymphaea alba phytochemistry and pharmacology review

## Clinical Pharmacy & Personalized Medicine

- [Analysis Of Drug Utilization Patterns In The Intensive Care Unit Of A Tertiary Care Hospital Using Who Core Prescribing Indicators A Retrospective Study](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Analysis-Of-Drug-Utilization-Patterns-In-The-Intensive-Care-Unit-Of-A-Tertiary-Care-Hospital-Using-Who-Core-Prescribing-Indicators-A-Retrospective-Study): Drug utilization patterns in ICU using WHO prescribing indicators
- [Pharmacogenomics](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Pharmacogenomics): Personalized medicine through genetic variation and drug metabolism
- [An Overview of Her 2 Neu Positive Breast Cancer](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/An-Overview-of-Her-2-Neu-Positive-Breast-Cancer): HER2-positive breast cancer overview with targeted therapy approaches

## Optional

- [A Step Toward the Future: Using Machine Learning to Detect Leukemia](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/A-Step-Toward-the-Future:-Using-Machine-Learning-to-Detect-Leukemia): Machine learning algorithms for leukemia detection via blood smear analysis
- [Nature's Code: Unravelling The Scientific Basis Of The Doctrine Of Signature And Its Role In Homoeopathic Remedies](https://www.ijpsjournal.com/article/Nature%E2%80%99s-Code:-Unravelling-The-Scientific-Basis-Of-The-Doctrine-Of-Signature-And-Its-Role-In-Homoeopathic-Remedies): Scientific examination of doctrine of signature in homoeopathic medicine
